title: 高層建築差異縮短補償
summary: 超高層的柱與核心筒在重力、潛變與收縮下持續縮短，若兩者縮短量不同，樓板會傾斜，連接構件與外伸臂會鎖入附加力，帷幕牆與電梯也會被拉扯。本課從縮短的三個來源與「安裝後縮短」的觀念出發，談構件尺寸、鋼—混凝土混合系統、標高補償、延遲接合時機、振弦式應變計與測量回饋，到非結構構件的容許變形與竣工後的長期追蹤，並以樂天世界塔、哈里發塔與世界貿易中心一號大樓的公開做法為例。
summaryEn: In a supertall building, columns and cores keep shortening under gravity, creep and shrinkage; when they shorten by different amounts, floors tilt, connecting members and outriggers lock in extra forces, and façades and elevators are strained. Starting from the three sources of shortening and the idea of post-installation shortening, the course covers member size, steel–concrete hybrid systems, level compensation, timing of delayed connections, vibrating-wire gauges and survey feedback, then tolerances of non-structural elements and long-term tracking after completion, illustrated by public practice at Lotte World Tower, Burj Khalifa and One World Trade Center.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：判斷一棟混凝土塔樓下部 30 層（120 m）是否需要差異縮短補償。周邊柱平均 σ = 18 MPa、E = 40 GPa、φ = 1.6、因斷面大取 ε_sh = 150 με：ε = 450 + 720 + 150 = 1,320 με，縮短 1,320×10⁻⁶×120,000 ≈ 158 mm。核心牆平均 σ = 9 MPa、φ = 1.6、因牆薄取 ε_sh = 280 με：ε = 225 + 360 + 280 = 865 με，縮短約 104 mm。差異約 54.6 mm，若柱與核心相距 12 m，樓板坡度 54.6/12,000 ≈ 1/220，超過教學採用的 1/360 準則，需要補償。若把柱放大使 σ 降到 14 MPa，柱應變 350 + 560 + 150 = 1,060 με，縮短約 127 mm，差異約 23.4 mm，坡度約 1/513，即可符合。注意這是總縮短，實際補償應以安裝後縮短計算。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: decide whether the lower 30 storeys (120 m) of a concrete tower need differential-shortening compensation. Perimeter columns average σ = 18 MPa with E = 40 GPa, φ = 1.6 and, because of their size, ε_sh = 150 με: ε = 450 + 720 + 150 = 1,320 με, a shortening of 1,320×10⁻⁶×120,000 ≈ 158 mm. Core walls average σ = 9 MPa with φ = 1.6 and, being thin, ε_sh = 280 με: ε = 225 + 360 + 280 = 865 με, about 104 mm. The difference is about 54.6 mm; with columns 12 m from the core, the floor slope is 54.6/12,000 ≈ 1/220, beyond the 1/360 teaching criterion, so compensation is needed. Enlarging the columns to bring σ down to 14 MPa gives 350 + 560 + 150 = 1,060 με, about 127 mm, a difference of about 23.4 mm and a slope of about 1/513, which complies. Note these are total shortenings; actual compensation should be based on post-installation shortening. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「縮短的三個來源」與「安裝後縮短與中段最大」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Three sources of shortening" and "Post-installation shortening peaks at mid-height": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 縮短的三個來源：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Three sources of shortening: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 混凝土豎向構件的縮短由三部分組成：加載時立即發生的彈性應變、在持續荷載下隨時間增加的潛變，以及與荷載無關、因水分散失而產生的收縮。潛變大致與應力成正比，通常以潛變係數 φ 乘上彈性應變表示；收縮則取決於濕度、構件尺寸與配比。周邊柱與核心牆的應力水準、斷面尺寸與加載時程不同，三部分加總後的總應變就不同，每層的差值會沿高度累積成數十毫米的差異縮短。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shortening of vertical concrete members has three parts: elastic strain that occurs immediately on loading, creep that grows with time under sustained load, and shrinkage that is independent of load and results from moisture loss. Creep is roughly proportional to stress and is usually expressed as a creep coefficient φ times the elastic strain; shrinkage depends on humidity, member size and mix. Perimeter columns and core walls differ in stress level, section size and loading history, so the sum of the three strains differs, and the storey-by-storey difference accumulates up the height into tens of millimetres of differential shortening. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：總應變 ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Total strain ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「柱子只在加載當下縮短，之後長度就不再改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A column shortens only at the moment of loading and its length then stays constant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 混凝土豎向構件的縮短由三部分組成：加載時立即發生的彈性應變、在持續荷載下隨時間增加的潛變，以及與荷載無關、因水分散失而產生的收縮。潛變大致與應力成正比，通常以潛變係數 φ 乘上彈性應變表示；收縮則取決於濕度、構件尺寸與配比。
knowledge.textEn: Shortening of vertical concrete members has three parts: elastic strain that occurs immediately on loading, creep that grows with time under sustained load, and shrinkage that is independent of load and results from moisture loss. Creep is roughly proportional to stress and is usually expressed as a creep coefficient φ times the elastic strain; shrinkage depends on humidity, member size and mix.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：柱子只在加載當下縮短，之後長度就不再改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A column shortens only at the moment of loading and its length then stays constant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「縮短的三個來源」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Three sources of shortening" is correct?
options: 柱子只在加載當下縮短，之後長度就不再改變。
混凝土豎向構件的縮短由三部分組成：加載時立即發生的彈性應變、在持續荷載下隨時間增加的潛變，以及與荷載無關、因水分散失而產生的收縮。
樓層越高，需要的縮短補償就越大。
optionsEn: A column shortens only at the moment of loading and its length then stays constant.

Shortening of vertical concrete members has three parts: elastic strain that occurs immediately on loading, creep that grows with time under sustained load, and shrinkage that is independent of load and results from moisture loss.
The higher the floor, the larger the shortening compensation it needs.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土豎向構件的縮短由三部分組成：加載時立即發生的彈性應變、在持續荷載下隨時間增加的潛變，以及與荷載無關、因水分散失而產生的收縮。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Shortening of vertical concrete members has three parts: elastic strain that occurs immediately on loading, creep that grows with time under sustained load, and shrinkage that is independent of load and results from moisture loss. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 縮短的三個來源：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Three sources of shortening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：總應變 ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh。柱：σ = 20 MPa、E = 40 GPa、φ = 1.5、ε_sh = 200 με → 500 + 750 + 200 = 1,450 με；核心牆：σ = 10 MPa、φ = 1.5、ε_sh = 300 με → 250 + 375 + 300 = 925 με。差值 525 με，在 4 m 層高等於每層約 2.1 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Total strain ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh. For a column with σ = 20 MPa, E = 40 GPa, φ = 1.5 and ε_sh = 200 με: 500 + 750 + 200 = 1,450 με; for a core wall with σ = 10 MPa, φ = 1.5 and ε_sh = 300 με: 250 + 375 + 300 = 925 με. The 525 με difference is about 2.1 mm per 4 m storey. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實際配比做潛變與收縮試驗（例如依 ASTM C512 與 C157），擬合潛變係數與收縮終值，代入預測模型；再比較 ACI 209、fib Model Code 與試驗擬合三種預測的差異，把差異範圍當作補償值的不確定性區間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes, for example to ASTM C512 and C157, fit the creep coefficient and ultimate shrinkage and feed them into the prediction model; compare predictions from ACI 209, the fib Model Code and the test fit to define an uncertainty band.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 總應變 ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh。柱：σ = 20 MPa、E = 40 GPa、φ = 1.5、ε_sh = 200 με → 500 + 750 + 200 = 1,450 με；核心牆：σ = 10 MPa、φ = 1.5、ε_sh = 300 με → 250 + 375 + 300 = 925 με。差值 525 με，在 4 m 層高等於每層約 2.1 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Total strain ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh. For a column with σ = 20 MPa, E = 40 GPa, φ = 1.5 and ε_sh = 200 με: 500 + 750 + 200 = 1,450 με; for a core wall with σ = 10 MPa, φ = 1.5 and ε_sh = 300 με: 250 + 375 + 300 = 925 με. The 525 με difference is about 2.1 mm per 4 m storey. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「縮短的三個來源」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Three sources of shortening", which statement holds?
options: 鋼柱沒有潛變，所以鋼—混凝土混合塔樓不會有差異縮短問題。
延遲接頭越晚鎖定越好，沒有任何代價。
總應變 ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh。
optionsEn: Steel columns do not creep, so steel–concrete hybrid towers have no differential-shortening problem.
Delay joints should always be locked as late as possible at no cost.
Total strain ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh.
quiz.explanation: 總應變 ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Total strain ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 縮短的三個來源：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Three sources of shortening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實際配比做潛變與收縮試驗（例如依 ASTM C512 與 C157），擬合潛變係數與收縮終值，代入預測模型；再比較 ACI 209、fib Model Code 與試驗擬合三種預測的差異，把差異範圍當作補償值的不確定性區間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes, for example to ASTM C512 and C157, fit the creep coefficient and ultimate shrinkage and feed them into the prediction model; compare predictions from ACI 209, the fib Model Code and the test fit to define an uncertainty band. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計初期就把柱與核心牆的應力比列為控制目標，並在規範中要求以實際配比做潛變收縮試驗，試驗結果須在主要結構施工前回饋到預測模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Treat the column-to-core stress ratio as a design target from the outset, and require creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes in the specification, with results fed back into the prediction model before major structural work begins.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只計算彈性縮短而忽略潛變與收縮，長期差異縮短可能被低估兩到三倍，完工數年後周邊樓板仍持續下沉，電梯門檻與帷幕牆接縫逐漸超出調整範圍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Computing only elastic shortening and ignoring creep and shrinkage can underestimate long-term differential shortening by two to three times, so perimeter floors keep dropping for years after completion and elevator sills and façade joints gradually run out of adjustment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以實際配比做潛變與收縮試驗（例如依 ASTM C512 與 C157），擬合潛變係數與收縮終值，代入預測模型；再比較 ACI 209、fib Model Code 與試驗擬合三種預測的差異，把差異範圍當作補償值的不確定性區間。
knowledge.textEn: Run creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes, for example to ASTM C512 and C157, fit the creep coefficient and ultimate shrinkage and feed them into the prediction model; compare predictions from ACI 209, the fib Model Code and the test fit to define an uncertainty band.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計初期就把柱與核心牆的應力比列為控制目標，並在規範中要求以實際配比做潛變收縮試驗，試驗結果須在主要結構施工前回饋到預測模型。
knowledge.textEn: Treat the column-to-core stress ratio as a design target from the outset, and require creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes in the specification, with results fed back into the prediction model before major structural work begins.

quiz.question: 要驗證「縮短的三個來源」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Three sources of shortening"?
options: 以實際配比做潛變與收縮試驗（例如依 ASTM C512 與 C157），擬合潛變係數與收縮終值，代入預測模型。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
設計階段的縮短預測一旦完成，施工中就不需要再修改。
optionsEn: Run creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes, for example to ASTM C512 and C157, fit the creep coefficient and ultimate shrinkage and feed them into the prediction model.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A design-stage shortening prediction never needs revising during construction.
quiz.explanation: 以實際配比做潛變與收縮試驗（例如依 ASTM C512 與 C157），擬合潛變係數與收縮終值，代入預測模型；再比較 ACI 209、fib Model Code 與試驗擬合三種預測的差異，把差異範圍當作補償值的不確定性區間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes, for example to ASTM C512 and C157, fit the creep coefficient and ultimate shrinkage and feed them into the prediction model; compare predictions from ACI 209, the fib Model Code and the test fit to define an uncertainty band. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 縮短的三個來源：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Three sources of shortening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

steps.title: 安裝後縮短與中段最大：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-installation shortening peaks at mid-height: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「安裝後縮短曲線」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-installation shortening profile” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 逐層施工時，每一層樓板都是在下方已經縮短之後才依設計標高施作，因此真正影響樓板高程與連接構件的，是該層安裝之後才發生的縮短。底部樓層安裝早，但其下方柱段很短；頂部樓層下方柱段很長，但安裝時上面已沒有新增荷重；結果安裝後縮短在中段附近最大，這與一次加載模型「越往上越大」的直覺相反。補償值因此必須依樓層逐一計算，而不是按高度比例分配。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「安裝後縮短曲線」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In storey-by-storey construction each floor is built to its design level after the structure below has already shortened, so what matters for floor levels and connecting members is the shortening that occurs after that floor is installed. Low floors are installed early but have little column below them; top floors have a long column below but receive almost no load after installation; post-installation shortening therefore peaks near mid-height, contrary to a one-step loading model in which shortening grows toward the top. Compensation must be computed floor by floor, not prorated by height. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-installation shortening profile” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：等斷面柱、每層荷重 P、每段勁度 k，第 i 層安裝後的彈性縮短 δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a uniform column with load P per floor and segment stiffness k, the elastic shortening after floor i is installed is δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樓層越高，需要的縮短補償就越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The higher the floor, the larger the shortening compensation it needs." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「安裝後縮短曲線」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 安裝後縮短與中段最大：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-installation shortening peaks at mid-height: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「安裝後縮短曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-installation shortening profile” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：等斷面柱、每層荷重 P、每段勁度 k，第 i 層安裝後的彈性縮短 δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k。N = 100、P/k = 0.01 mm：δ₂₅ = 25×75×0.01 ≈ 18.8 mm，δ₅₀ = 25.0 mm（最大），δ₇₅ ≈ 18.8 mm，δ₁₀₀ = 0。數值為教學假設，未含時間相依效應。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a uniform column with load P per floor and segment stiffness k, the elastic shortening after floor i is installed is δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k. With N = 100 and P/k = 0.01 mm: δ₂₅ = 25×75×0.01 ≈ 18.8 mm, δ₅₀ = 25.0 mm (maximum), δ₇₅ ≈ 18.8 mm and δ₁₀₀ = 0. Values are teaching assumptions without time-dependent effects. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段分析逐層啟動構件與荷重，輸出每層安裝後的縮短曲線，並以手算 i(N − i) 型式核對趨勢；施工中每隔數層以精密水準量測樓板相對於設計標高的偏差，檢查實測曲線形狀是否與預測一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Activate members and loads floor by floor in a construction-stage analysis and output the post-installation shortening profile, checking its trend against the hand-derived i(N − i) form; during construction, level-survey floor deviations from design elevations every few floors and check that the measured profile matches the predicted shape.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 以施工階段分析逐層啟動構件與荷重，輸出每層安裝後的縮短曲線，並以手算 i(N − i) 型式核對趨勢；施工中每隔數層以精密水準量測樓板相對於設計標高的偏差，檢查實測曲線形狀是否與預測一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：補償表應明確區分「總縮短」與「安裝後縮短」，並註明採用的施工速度假設；施工進度若明顯變快或變慢，須由結構工程師重新計算後續樓層的補償值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compensation tables must distinguish total from post-installation shortening and state the assumed construction speed; if progress becomes much faster or slower, the structural engineer must recalculate compensation for later floors.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以一次加載模型的結果做補償，頂部樓層會被過度預抬、中段補償不足，完工後頂部樓板高於設計、中段低於設計，電梯導軌與管道立管被迫在現場切改。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Compensating from a one-step loading model over-raises the top floors and under-compensates mid-height, leaving upper floors high and middle floors low after completion and forcing site modifications to elevator rails and risers. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-installation shortening profile” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以一次加載模型的結果做補償，頂部樓層會被過度預抬、中段補償不足，完工後頂部樓板高於設計、中段低於設計，電梯導軌與管道立管被迫在現場切改。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Compensating from a one-step loading model over-raises the top floors and under-compensates mid-height, leaving upper floors high and middle floors low after completion and forcing site modifications to elevator rails and risers. steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher the floor, the larger the shortening compensation it needs." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「構件尺寸對潛變收縮的影響」與「鋼—混凝土混合系統的縮短差」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effect of member size on creep and shrinkage" and "Shortening mismatch in steel–concrete hybrids": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 構件尺寸對潛變收縮的影響：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Effect of member size on creep and shrinkage: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「體表比與收縮速率」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Volume-to-surface ratio and shrinkage” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 收縮與乾燥潛變需要水分從混凝土表面散失，所以構件的體積與表面積比（V/S）越大，水分路徑越長，收縮越慢、越小。粗大的周邊巨柱 V/S 大，薄核心牆 V/S 小，兩者即使用同一配比，收縮也可能差近一倍；牆的收縮甚至可能讓核心筒縮短得比柱更多。高強混凝土的潛變係數一般較低，但自體收縮較大，因此在不同高度改變強度或構件尺寸，都會改變差異縮短的方向與大小。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「體表比與收縮速率」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinkage and drying creep require moisture to leave through the surface, so the larger a member's volume-to-surface ratio (V/S), the longer the moisture path and the slower and smaller the shrinkage. Massive perimeter mega-columns have high V/S and thin core walls low V/S, so even with the same mix their shrinkage can differ by nearly a factor of two, and wall shrinkage can make the core shorten more than the columns. High-strength concrete generally has a lower creep coefficient but higher autogenous shrinkage, so changing strength or member size at different heights changes both the direction and the size of differential shortening. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Volume-to-surface ratio and shrinkage” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 209 收縮的體表比修正 γ_vs = 1.2·exp(−0.00472·V/S)（V/S 以 mm 計）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 209's volume-to-surface correction for shrinkage is γ_vs = 1.2·exp(−0.00472·V/S) with V/S in mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一配比的混凝土無論做成牆或柱，收縮量都一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The same concrete mix shrinks the same amount whether it is cast as a wall or a column." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「體表比與收縮速率」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Volume-to-surface ratio and shrinkage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 構件尺寸對潛變收縮的影響
knowledge.titleEn: Effect of member size on creep and shrinkage
knowledge.text: 收縮與乾燥潛變需要水分從混凝土表面散失，所以構件的體積與表面積比（V/S）越大，水分路徑越長，收縮越慢、越小。粗大的周邊巨柱 V/S 大，薄核心牆 V/S 小，兩者即使用同一配比，收縮也可能差近一倍；牆的收縮甚至可能讓核心筒縮短得比柱更多。

Massive perimeter mega-columns have high V/S and thin core walls low V/S, so even with the same mix their shrinkage can differ by nearly a factor of two, and wall shrinkage can make the core shorten more than the columns.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一配比的混凝土無論做成牆或柱，收縮量都一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The same concrete mix shrinks the same amount whether it is cast as a wall or a column. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「構件尺寸對潛變收縮的影響」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effect of member size on creep and shrinkage" is correct?
options: 收縮與乾燥潛變需要水分從混凝土表面散失，所以構件的體積與表面積比（V/S）越大，水分路徑越長，收縮越慢、越小。
同一配比的混凝土無論做成牆或柱，收縮量都一樣。
鋼柱沒有潛變，所以鋼—混凝土混合塔樓不會有差異縮短問題。
optionsEn: Shrinkage and drying creep require moisture to leave through the surface, so the larger a member's volume-to-surface ratio (V/S), the longer the moisture path and the slower and smaller the shrinkage.
The same concrete mix shrinks the same amount whether it is cast as a wall or a column.
Steel columns do not creep, so steel–concrete hybrid towers have no differential-shortening problem.
quiz.explanation: 收縮與乾燥潛變需要水分從混凝土表面散失，所以構件的體積與表面積比（V/S）越大，水分路徑越長，收縮越慢、越小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Shrinkage and drying creep require moisture to leave through the surface, so the larger a member's volume-to-surface ratio (V/S), the longer the moisture path and the slower and smaller the shrinkage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 構件尺寸對潛變收縮的影響：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effect of member size on creep and shrinkage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「體表比與收縮速率」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Volume-to-surface ratio and shrinkage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 209 收縮的體表比修正 γ_vs = 1.2·exp(−0.00472·V/S)（V/S 以 mm 計）。1.5 m 方柱 V/S = 1,500²/(4×1,500) = 375 mm，γ_vs ≈ 0.204；500 mm 雙面乾燥的牆 V/S = 250 mm，γ_vs ≈ 0.369；牆的最終收縮約為柱的 1.8 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 209's volume-to-surface correction for shrinkage is γ_vs = 1.2·exp(−0.00472·V/S) with V/S in mm. A 1.5 m square column has V/S = 1,500²/(4×1,500) = 375 mm and γ_vs ≈ 0.204; a 500 mm wall drying on both faces has V/S = 250 mm and γ_vs ≈ 0.369, so the wall's ultimate shrinkage is about 1.8 times the column's. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製作與實際構件同 V/S 的大型試體或在構件中埋設應變計，量測收縮發展曲線，與小型標準試體的結果比較，修正尺寸效應；混凝土強度或斷面改變的樓層須在預測模型中單獨分段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cast large specimens with the same V/S as real members, or embed gauges in the members, to measure shrinkage development and compare with small standard specimens to correct for size effect; floors where strength or section changes must be modelled as separate segments.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ACI 209 收縮的體表比修正 γ_vs = 1.2·exp(−0.00472·V/S)（V/S 以 mm 計）。1.5 m 方柱 V/S = 1,500²/(4×1,500) = 375 mm，γ_vs ≈ 0.204；500 mm 雙面乾燥的牆 V/S = 250 mm，γ_vs ≈ 0.369；牆的最終收縮約為柱的 1.8 倍。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: ACI 209's volume-to-surface correction for shrinkage is γ_vs = 1.2·exp(−0.00472·V/S) with V/S in mm. A 1.5 m square column has V/S = 1,500²/(4×1,500) = 375 mm and γ_vs ≈ 0.204; a 500 mm wall drying on both faces has V/S = 250 mm and γ_vs ≈ 0.369, so the wall's ultimate shrinkage is about 1.8 times the column's. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「構件尺寸對潛變收縮的影響」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effect of member size on creep and shrinkage", which statement holds?
options: 延遲接頭越晚鎖定越好，沒有任何代價。
ACI 209 收縮的體表比修正 γ_vs = 1.2·exp(−0.00472·V/S)（V/S 以 mm 計）。
設計階段的縮短預測一旦完成，施工中就不需要再修改。
optionsEn: Delay joints should always be locked as late as possible at no cost.
ACI 209's volume-to-surface correction for shrinkage is γ_vs = 1.2·exp(−0.00472·V/S) with V/S in mm.
A design-stage shortening prediction never needs revising during construction.
quiz.explanation: ACI 209 收縮的體表比修正 γ_vs = 1.2·exp(−0.00472·V/S)（V/S 以 mm 計）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ACI 209's volume-to-surface correction for shrinkage is γ_vs = 1.2·exp(−0.00472·V/S) with V/S in mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 構件尺寸對潛變收縮的影響：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effect of member size on creep and shrinkage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「體表比與收縮速率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Volume-to-surface ratio and shrinkage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 製作與實際構件同 V/S 的大型試體或在構件中埋設應變計，量測收縮發展曲線，與小型標準試體的結果比較，修正尺寸效應；混凝土強度或斷面改變的樓層須在預測模型中單獨分段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cast large specimens with the same V/S as real members, or embed gauges in the members, to measure shrinkage development and compare with small standard specimens to correct for size effect; floors where strength or section changes must be modelled as separate segments. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預測報告應列出每個構件群組的 V/S、混凝土強度、加載齡期與採用的收縮潛變參數，並在施工中更換配比或構件尺寸時重新評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The prediction report should list V/S, concrete strength, loading age and the creep and shrinkage parameters for each member group, and be re-evaluated whenever mixes or member sizes change during construction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以小試體的收縮直接套用到巨柱，會高估巨柱收縮、低估核心牆收縮，補償方向錯誤，完工後核心筒周邊樓板反而下傾，連接梁出現與預期相反的裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying small-specimen shrinkage directly to mega-columns overestimates column shrinkage and underestimates wall shrinkage, so compensation goes the wrong way: after completion floors slope down toward the core and link beams crack in the opposite sense to that expected. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 製作與實際構件同 V/S 的大型試體或在構件中埋設應變計，量測收縮發展曲線，與小型標準試體的結果比較，修正尺寸效應；混凝土強度或斷面改變的樓層須在預測模型中單獨分段。
knowledge.textEn: Cast large specimens with the same V/S as real members, or embed gauges in the members, to measure shrinkage development and compare with small standard specimens to correct for size effect; floors where strength or section changes must be modelled as separate segments.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 預測報告應列出每個構件群組的 V/S、混凝土強度、加載齡期與採用的收縮潛變參數，並在施工中更換配比或構件尺寸時重新評估。
knowledge.textEn: The prediction report should list V/S, concrete strength, loading age and the creep and shrinkage parameters for each member group, and be re-evaluated whenever mixes or member sizes change during construction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「構件尺寸對潛變收縮的影響」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effect of member size on creep and shrinkage"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
大樓完工後，柱與核心筒的縮短就已經全部結束。
製作與實際構件同 V/S 的大型試體或在構件中埋設應變計，量測收縮發展曲線，與小型標準試體的結果比較，修正尺寸效應。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once the building is complete, column and core shortening has finished.
Cast large specimens with the same V/S as real members, or embed gauges in the members, to measure shrinkage development and compare with small standard specimens to correct for size effect.
quiz.explanation: 製作與實際構件同 V/S 的大型試體或在構件中埋設應變計，量測收縮發展曲線，與小型標準試體的結果比較，修正尺寸效應；混凝土強度或斷面改變的樓層須在預測模型中單獨分段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cast large specimens with the same V/S as real members, or embed gauges in the members, to measure shrinkage development and compare with small standard specimens to correct for size effect; floors where strength or section changes must be modelled as separate segments. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 構件尺寸對潛變收縮的影響：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effect of member size on creep and shrinkage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「體表比與收縮速率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Volume-to-surface ratio and shrinkage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以小試體的收縮直接套用到巨柱，會高估巨柱收縮、低估核心牆收縮，補償方向錯誤，完工後核心筒周邊樓板反而下傾，連接梁出現與預期相反的裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying small-specimen shrinkage directly to mega-columns overestimates column shrinkage and underestimates wall shrinkage, so compensation goes the wrong way: after completion floors slope down toward the core and link beams crack in the opposite sense to that expected. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高強混凝土的潛變係數一般較低，但自體收縮較大，因此在不同高度改變強度或構件尺寸，都會改變差異縮短的方向與大小。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: High-strength concrete generally has a lower creep coefficient but higher autogenous shrinkage, so changing strength or member size at different heights changes both the direction and the size of differential shortening.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一配比的混凝土無論做成牆或柱，收縮量都一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The same concrete mix shrinks the same amount whether it is cast as a wall or a column." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 鋼—混凝土混合系統的縮短差：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shortening mismatch in steel–concrete hybrids: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼柱與混凝土核心的混合系統」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel columns with a concrete core” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 許多超高層採用混凝土核心筒搭配鋼柱或鋼骨混凝土柱的混合系統。鋼柱沒有潛變與收縮，但服務應力高、彈性應變大；混凝土核心應力低，但會持續潛變收縮。哪一方縮短較多取決於兩者的數值，常見情況是核心筒在長期中縮短較多，與純混凝土塔樓的「柱縮短較多」方向相反。世界貿易中心一號大樓的核心混凝土配比同時針對強度、模數、潛變與收縮設計，就是為了讓核心筒的變形可被準確預測，與周邊鋼框架協調。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼柱與混凝土核心的混合系統」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Many supertall towers combine a concrete core with steel or composite columns. Steel columns do not creep or shrink but carry high service stress and large elastic strain; the concrete core is less stressed but keeps creeping and shrinking. Which shortens more depends on the numbers, and often the core shortens more in the long term, the opposite of the column-shortens-more pattern of all-concrete towers. At One World Trade Center the core mixes were designed for strength, modulus, creep and shrinkage together precisely so that core deformation could be predicted accurately and coordinated with the perimeter steel frame. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Steel columns with a concrete core” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鋼柱 σ = 160 MPa、E = 200 GPa：ε = 800 με。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A steel column at σ = 160 MPa with E = 200 GPa has ε = 800 με.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼柱沒有潛變，所以鋼—混凝土混合塔樓不會有差異縮短問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steel columns do not creep, so steel–concrete hybrid towers have no differential-shortening problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼柱與混凝土核心的混合系統」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Steel columns with a concrete core”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼—混凝土混合系統的縮短差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 鋼—混凝土混合系統的縮短差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shortening mismatch in steel–concrete hybrids: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼柱與混凝土核心的混合系統」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel columns with a concrete core” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鋼柱 σ = 160 MPa、E = 200 GPa：ε = 800 με。混凝土核心 σ = 12 MPa、E = 38 GPa、φ = 2.0、ε_sh = 250 με：ε = 316 + 632 + 250 ≈ 1,197 με。差值約 397 με，在 250 m 高度累積約 99 mm，核心筒縮短較多。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A steel column at σ = 160 MPa with E = 200 GPa has ε = 800 με. A concrete core at σ = 12 MPa with E = 38 GPa, φ = 2.0 and ε_sh = 250 με has ε = 316 + 632 + 250 ≈ 1,197 με. The difference of about 397 με accumulates to about 99 mm over 250 m, with the core shortening more. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以時間相依的施工階段分析分別追蹤鋼柱與核心筒在每層安裝後的縮短，確認差異方向；鋼柱可在工廠依補償值調整柱長或在續接處加墊片，現場以水準量測核對每節柱頂標高。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use time-dependent construction-stage analysis to track post-installation shortening of steel columns and core separately and confirm the direction of the difference; steel columns can be lengthened in the shop or shimmed at splices according to the compensation values, and each tier's column-top level is checked by site levelling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鋼柱 σ = 160 MPa、E = 200 GPa：ε = 800 με。混凝土核心 σ = 12 MPa、E = 38 GPa、φ = 2.0、ε_sh = 250 με：ε = 316 + 632 + 250 ≈ 1,197 με。差值約 397 με，在 250 m 高度累積約 99 mm，核心筒縮短較多。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A steel column at σ = 160 MPa with E = 200 GPa has ε = 800 με. A concrete core at σ = 12 MPa with E = 38 GPa, φ = 2.0 and ε_sh = 250 με has ε = 316 + 632 + 250 ≈ 1,197 με. The difference of about 397 με accumulates to about 99 mm over 250 m, with the core shortening more. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼—混凝土混合系統的縮短差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shortening mismatch in steel–concrete hybrids", which statement holds?
options: 應變計讀到的應變全部都是荷載造成的。
差異縮短只是結構問題，與帷幕牆、隔間和電梯無關。
鋼柱 σ = 160 MPa、E = 200 GPa：ε = 800 με。
optionsEn: All strain read by a gauge is caused by load.
Differential shortening is purely a structural matter and has nothing to do with façades, partitions or elevators.
A steel column at σ = 160 MPa with E = 200 GPa has ε = 800 με.
quiz.explanation: 鋼柱 σ = 160 MPa、E = 200 GPa：ε = 800 με。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A steel column at σ = 160 MPa with E = 200 GPa has ε = 800 με. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼—混凝土混合系統的縮短差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shortening mismatch in steel–concrete hybrids: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼柱與混凝土核心的混合系統」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steel columns with a concrete core” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以時間相依的施工階段分析分別追蹤鋼柱與核心筒在每層安裝後的縮短，確認差異方向；鋼柱可在工廠依補償值調整柱長或在續接處加墊片，現場以水準量測核對每節柱頂標高。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use time-dependent construction-stage analysis to track post-installation shortening of steel columns and core separately and confirm the direction of the difference; steel columns can be lengthened in the shop or shimmed at splices according to the compensation values, and each tier's column-top level is checked by site levelling. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：混合系統的補償須同時規劃混凝土核心的澆置標高與鋼柱的工廠長度，兩者由同一份補償表管理，並在鋼柱製造前凍結當節的補償值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: In hybrid systems plan concrete core casting levels and steel column shop lengths together from one compensation table, freezing each tier's values before the columns are fabricated.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若沿用純混凝土塔樓的經驗把鋼柱預抬，卻沒有發現核心筒才是縮短較多的一方，差異會加倍：周邊樓板高於核心，樓板梁端與外伸臂承受反向的附加力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Raising steel columns out of habit from all-concrete towers, without noticing that the core is the one that shortens more, doubles the difference: perimeter floors end up higher than the core and beam ends and outriggers carry reversed additional forces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以時間相依的施工階段分析分別追蹤鋼柱與核心筒在每層安裝後的縮短，確認差異方向；鋼柱可在工廠依補償值調整柱長或在續接處加墊片，現場以水準量測核對每節柱頂標高。

knowledge.text: 混合系統的補償須同時規劃混凝土核心的澆置標高與鋼柱的工廠長度，兩者由同一份補償表管理，並在鋼柱製造前凍結當節的補償值。

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shortening mismatch in steel–concrete hybrids"?

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "How level compensation is applied" and "Delay joints and when to lock them": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 標高補償的施作方法：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: How level compensation is applied: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「澆置與安裝標高預抬」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Casting and erection level corrections” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 補償的基本做法是在每層施作時把構件設在「設計標高加上預測的安裝後縮短」：混凝土核心在爬模放樣時抬高模板，鋼柱在工廠加長或在續接處加墊片，樓板梁的接頭則預留可調高度。補償通常以固定級距（例如 5 mm）分段施加，以便現場執行與檢查。樂天世界塔的設計者也以施工中對巨柱垂直預拱的方式，處理核心筒與周邊之間的差異沉陷，屬同一種預先抵銷的思路。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「澆置與安裝標高預抬」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The basic method is to set each element at its design level plus the predicted post-installation shortening: climbing forms for the concrete core are set high, steel columns are lengthened in the shop or shimmed at splices, and floor-beam connections are given adjustable height. Compensation is usually applied in fixed increments, for example 5 mm, so it can be executed and checked on site. At Lotte World Tower the designers also vertically cambered the mega-columns during construction to offset differential settlement between core and perimeter, the same idea of cancelling movement in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Casting and erection level corrections” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：第 60 層（N = 100）安裝後彈性縮短 δ = 60×40×0.012 ≈ 28.8 mm，乘上時間相依放大 1.6 得約 46 mm；以 5 mm 級距施作取 +45 mm，殘差約 1 mm，再與測量允差 ±10 mm 合併評估。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For floor 60 of N = 100, post-installation elastic shortening is δ = 60×40×0.012 ≈ 28.8 mm; a time-dependent factor of 1.6 gives about 46 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「差異縮短只能在完工後以調整裝修高度來處理。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Differential shortening can only be dealt with after completion by adjusting finish levels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「澆置與安裝標高預抬」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 標高補償的施作方法：定量估算
steps.titleEn: How level compensation is applied: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「澆置與安裝標高預抬」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Casting and erection level corrections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：第 60 層（N = 100）安裝後彈性縮短 δ = 60×40×0.012 ≈ 28.8 mm，乘上時間相依放大 1.6 得約 46 mm；以 5 mm 級距施作取 +45 mm，殘差約 1 mm，再與測量允差 ±10 mm 合併評估。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For floor 60 of N = 100, post-installation elastic shortening is δ = 60×40×0.012 ≈ 28.8 mm; a time-dependent factor of 1.6 gives about 46 mm. Applied in 5 mm increments, +45 mm is used with a residual of about 1 mm, then combined with the ±10 mm survey tolerance. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每層澆置或安裝後以精密水準量測實際標高，與「設計標高 + 補償值」比較，偏差超出允差時記錄原因並在下一級補償中調整；墊片數量與厚度應逐柱記錄並拍照存檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each floor is cast or erected, measure actual levels by precise levelling and compare with design level plus compensation; record the cause of any out-of-tolerance deviation and correct in the next increment, and log and photograph shim count and thickness column by column.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 標高補償的施作方法：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: How level compensation is applied: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「澆置與安裝標高預抬」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Casting and erection level corrections” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每層澆置或安裝後以精密水準量測實際標高，與「設計標高 + 補償值」比較，偏差超出允差時記錄原因並在下一級補償中調整；墊片數量與厚度應逐柱記錄並拍照存檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each floor is cast or erected, measure actual levels by precise levelling and compare with design level plus compensation; record the cause of any out-of-tolerance deviation and correct in the next increment, and log and photograph shim count and thickness column by column. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：補償表由結構工程師統一發布並編版號，測量與鋼構製造只能使用最新版本；每節補償施作後的量測紀錄列為進入下一節的停留點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural engineer issues one versioned compensation table that surveyors and steel fabricators must use in its latest revision, and the as-built measurement after each increment is a hold point before the next tier.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若補償表版本混亂，測量團隊用舊版放樣，可能在數層內累積數十毫米的錯誤；墊片疊太多層而未焊固，日後在反覆荷載下可能滑出，造成局部沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If compensation tables are poorly version-controlled and surveyors set out from an old revision, tens of millimetres of error can build up within a few floors; stacks of too many unwelded shims can work loose under repeated load and cause local settlement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: After each floor is cast or erected, measure actual levels by precise levelling and compare with design level plus compensation; record the cause of any out-of-tolerance deviation and correct in the next increment, and log and photograph shim count and thickness column by column.

knowledge.textEn: The structural engineer issues one versioned compensation table that surveyors and steel fabricators must use in its latest revision, and the as-built measurement after each increment is a hold point before the next tier.

quiz.question: 要驗證「標高補償的施作方法」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。

steps.title: 延遲接頭與鎖定時機：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Delay joints and when to lock them: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「延遲接合時機」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Timing of delayed connections” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外伸臂、帶狀桁架或連接核心與周邊柱的剛性構件若在施工早期就鎖定，之後的差異縮短會全部轉成構件內力。樂天世界塔的設計論文指出設置了延遲接頭以限制差異縮短產生的額外構件力，核心牆與巨柱在框架完成後才相連；報導也提到帶狀桁架接頭使用長槽孔，於完工後才鎖緊。鎖定時機是一個取捨：越晚鎖定，殘餘縮短越少；但鎖定前結構缺少這些構件提供的勁度，施工期的側向穩定與颱風、地震下的變位必須另行檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「延遲接合時機」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: If outriggers, belt trusses or other stiff members linking core and perimeter columns are locked early, all later differential shortening turns into member forces. The Lotte World Tower design paper says delay joints were installed to limit the extra member forces from differential shortening, with core walls and mega-columns connected only after the frame was complete; reports also mention long-slotted belt-truss connections tightened after completion. Locking time is a trade-off: the later the lock, the less residual shortening, but until then the structure lacks the stiffness these members provide, so construction-stage stability and drift under typhoon or earthquake must be checked separately. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Timing of delayed connections” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ACI 209 潛變時間函數 φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6)（t 為加載後天數）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 209's creep time function is φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6), with t in days after loading.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「延遲接頭越晚鎖定越好，沒有任何代價。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Delay joints should always be locked as late as possible at no cost." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「延遲接合時機」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 延遲接頭與鎖定時機：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Delay joints and when to lock them: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「延遲接合時機」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Timing of delayed connections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ACI 209 潛變時間函數 φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6)（t 為加載後天數）。加載後 90 天鎖定：90^0.6 ≈ 14.9，已完成 14.9/24.9 ≈ 60%，剩餘約 40%；365 天鎖定：365^0.6 ≈ 34.5，完成約 78%，剩餘約 22%，鎖定後潛變附加力約減少一半。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 209's creep time function is φ(t)/φ_u = t^0.6/(10 + t^0.6), with t in days after loading. Locking 90 days after loading: 90^0.6 ≈ 14.9, so 14.9/24.9 ≈ 60% has occurred and about 40% remains; locking at 365 days: 365^0.6 ≈ 34.5, about 78% has occurred and about 22% remains, roughly halving the creep-induced force after locking. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以時間相依分析比較數個鎖定時點下的構件附加力與施工期側向變位，選定後寫入施工規範；鎖定前量測接頭兩側的相對位移與槽孔餘裕，鎖定後在構件上以應變計追蹤附加力的增長。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use time-dependent analysis to compare added member forces and construction-stage drift for several locking times, then write the chosen time into the specification; before locking measure relative movement across the joint and remaining slot travel, and afterwards track the growth of added force with strain gauges on the members.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「延遲接頭與鎖定時機」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 延遲接頭與鎖定時機：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Delay joints and when to lock them: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「延遲接合時機」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Timing of delayed connections” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以時間相依分析比較數個鎖定時點下的構件附加力與施工期側向變位，選定後寫入施工規範；鎖定前量測接頭兩側的相對位移與槽孔餘裕，鎖定後在構件上以應變計追蹤附加力的增長。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use time-dependent analysis to compare added member forces and construction-stage drift for several locking times, then write the chosen time into the specification; before locking measure relative movement across the joint and remaining slot travel, and afterwards track the growth of added force with strain gauges on the members. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：延遲接頭的鎖定列為停留點，條件包括：達到指定樓層或荷重比例、監測顯示差異縮短速率低於門檻、施工期颱風或地震檢核仍然滿足，並由結構工程師書面放行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Locking delay joints is a hold point released in writing by the structural engineer when a set floor or load fraction is reached, monitoring shows the differential-shortening rate below a threshold and construction-stage wind and seismic checks are still satisfied.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若為了施工方便提早全部鎖定，差異縮短在外伸臂內鎖入的附加力可能使接頭螺栓滑移或焊道開裂；若延遲太久而未補足施工期勁度，強風下未完工結構的變位可能超出允許值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Locking everything early for convenience can let differential shortening lock enough added force into outriggers to slip joint bolts or crack welds; delaying too long without temporary stiffness can let the incomplete structure exceed allowable drift in strong wind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以時間相依分析比較數個鎖定時點下的構件附加力與施工期側向變位，選定後寫入施工規範；鎖定前量測接頭兩側的相對位移與槽孔餘裕，鎖定後在構件上以應變計追蹤附加力的增長。

knowledge.text: 延遲接頭的鎖定列為停留點，條件包括：達到指定樓層或荷重比例、監測顯示差異縮短速率低於門檻、施工期颱風或地震檢核仍然滿足，並由結構工程師書面放行。

quiz.question: 要驗證「延遲接頭與鎖定時機」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Delay joints and when to lock them"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
同一配比的混凝土無論做成牆或柱，收縮量都一樣。

quiz.explanationEn: Use time-dependent analysis to compare added member forces and construction-stage drift for several locking times, then write the chosen time into the specification; before locking measure relative movement across the joint and remaining slot travel, and afterwards track the growth of added force with strain gauges on the members. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 以振弦式應變計量測縮短：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「振弦式應變計」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vibrating-wire strain gauges” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 振弦式應變計把一根張緊的鋼弦固定在兩個錨端之間並埋入混凝土，構件縮短時鋼弦張力改變，其自然頻率隨之改變；讀取頻率的平方差即可換算應變。它長期穩定、適合埋設在柱與核心牆中多年監測，並通常內建溫度感測器，用來修正鋼弦與混凝土熱膨脹差造成的視應變。量到的總應變包含彈性、潛變、收縮與溫度，因此需要搭配無應力計（不受荷載的同批混凝土）把收縮與溫度分離出來。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「振弦式應變計」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A vibrating-wire gauge holds a tensioned steel wire between two anchors embedded in the concrete; as the member shortens, the wire tension and therefore its natural frequency change, and the difference of the squared frequency readings converts to strain. Gauges are stable for years and suit long-term embedment in columns and core walls, usually with a built-in thermistor to correct the apparent strain from different thermal expansion of wire and concrete. The measured total includes elastic, creep, shrinkage and thermal strain, so no-stress companion gauges in unloaded concrete from the same pour are needed to separate shrinkage and temperature. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Vibrating-wire strain gauges” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ε = G(f₁² − f₀²)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ε = G(f₁² − f₀²).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「應變計讀到的應變全部都是荷載造成的。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 以振弦式應變計量測縮短：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「振弦式應變計」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vibrating-wire strain gauges” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ε = G(f₁² − f₀²)。取儀器係數 G = 4.0×10⁻³ με/Hz²，初讀 f₀ = 800 Hz、後讀 f₁ = 780 Hz：ε = 4.0×10⁻³×(608,400 − 640,000) ≈ −126 με（壓縮）。若無應力計同期讀到 −50 με，則與荷載相關的應變約 −76 με。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ε = G(f₁² − f₀²). With a gauge factor G = 4.0×10⁻³ με/Hz², an initial reading f₀ = 800 Hz and a later reading f₁ = 780 Hz, ε = 4.0×10⁻³×(608,400 − 640,000) ≈ −126 με, in compression. If a companion no-stress gauge reads −50 με over the same period, the load-related strain is about −76 με. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝前檢查每支儀器的出廠校正與編號，澆置前後各讀一次確認存活；以混凝土剛澆置後、尚未加載時的讀數作為零點，並同步記錄溫度、樓層進度與澆置日期；定期以手持讀數儀抽查自動資料擷取器的讀數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before installation check each gauge's calibration certificate and serial number, and read before and after casting to confirm survival; take the zero reading after casting but before loading, logging temperature, construction progress and pour date; periodically spot-check the automatic data logger with a hand-held readout.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With a gauge factor G = 4.0×10⁻³ με/Hz², an initial reading f₀ = 800 Hz and a later reading f₁ = 780 Hz, ε = 4.0×10⁻³×(608,400 − 640,000) ≈ −126 με, in compression. If a companion no-stress gauge reads −50 με over the same period, the load-related strain is about −76 με. Values are teaching assumptions.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「振弦式應變計」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vibrating-wire strain gauges” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝前檢查每支儀器的出廠校正與編號，澆置前後各讀一次確認存活；以混凝土剛澆置後、尚未加載時的讀數作為零點，並同步記錄溫度、樓層進度與澆置日期；定期以手持讀數儀抽查自動資料擷取器的讀數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before installation check each gauge's calibration certificate and serial number, and read before and after casting to confirm survival; take the zero reading after casting but before loading, logging temperature, construction progress and pour date; periodically spot-check the automatic data logger with a hand-held readout. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測計畫要規定每個監測斷面的應變計數量、無應力計配置、纜線保護路徑與備援，並把零點時間與施工紀錄綁在同一資料庫，供結構工程師判讀。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The monitoring plan should define the number of gauges per section, no-stress gauges, protected cable routes and redundancy, linking zero-reading times with construction records in one database for the structural engineer's interpretation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：零點取在已經加載之後、或未做溫度修正，量到的應變會偏離真實值數十微應變；感測器纜線在後續施工中被切斷而沒有備援，長期資料出現斷層，無法回推縮短曲線。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Taking the zero after loading has begun, or omitting temperature correction, shifts measured strain by tens of microstrain; cables cut during later work with no redundancy leave gaps in the long-term record so the shortening curve cannot be reconstructed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vibrating-wire strain gauges” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 零點取在已經加載之後、或未做溫度修正，量到的應變會偏離真實值數十微應變；感測器纜線在後續施工中被切斷而沒有備援，長期資料出現斷層，無法回推縮短曲線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Taking the zero after loading has begun, or omitting temperature correction, shifts measured strain by tens of microstrain; cables cut during later work with no redundancy leave gaps in the long-term record so the shortening curve cannot be reconstructed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量到的總應變包含彈性、潛變、收縮與溫度，因此需要搭配無應力計（不受荷載的同批混凝土）把收縮與溫度分離出來。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The measured total includes elastic, creep, shrinkage and thermal strain, so no-stress companion gauges in unloaded concrete from the same pour are needed to separate shrinkage and temperature.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「應變計讀到的應變全部都是荷載造成的。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All strain read by a gauge is caused by load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 實測與預測比對後的更新：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Updating predictions from measurements: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「測量回饋與預測更新」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Survey feedback and prediction update” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預測模型的潛變收縮參數、加載時程與施工速度都有不確定性，因此施工中必須以應變計與水準測量的結果回頭修正預測。報導指出樂天世界塔的在地結構技師在施工中重新計算差異縮短，正是這種回饋。常見做法是比較已完成樓層的實測縮短與同齡期的預測值，求出修正比例，再套用到尚未施工樓層的補償值；若偏差呈系統性（例如所有實測值都偏小），應檢討模數或潛變係數，而不是只做比例縮放。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「測量回饋與預測更新」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The creep and shrinkage parameters, loading history and construction speed in a prediction model are uncertain, so strain gauge and levelling results must be fed back during construction. Reports note that the local engineer of record at Lotte World Tower recalculated differential shortening during construction, which is exactly this feedback. A common approach compares measured shortening of completed floors with predictions at the same age, derives a correction ratio and applies it to compensation for floors not yet built; if the deviation is systematic, for example all measurements smaller, the modulus or creep coefficient should be revisited rather than merely scaled. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Survey feedback and prediction update” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：第 30 層實測安裝後縮短 18 mm，同齡期預測 24 mm，修正比 18/24 = 0.75。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At floor 30 the measured post-installation shortening is 18 mm against 24 mm predicted at the same age, a correction ratio of 18/24 = 0.75.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設計階段的縮短預測一旦完成，施工中就不需要再修改。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A design-stage shortening prediction never needs revising during construction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「測量回饋與預測更新」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Survey feedback and prediction update”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 實測與預測比對後的更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Updating predictions from measurements: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測量回饋與預測更新」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Survey feedback and prediction update” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：第 30 層實測安裝後縮短 18 mm，同齡期預測 24 mm，修正比 18/24 = 0.75。若第 70 層原預測剩餘補償 30 mm，更新後約 30×0.75 = 22.5 mm，以 5 mm 級距取 +20 或 +25 mm，並由後續量測決定。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At floor 30 the measured post-installation shortening is 18 mm against 24 mm predicted at the same age, a correction ratio of 18/24 = 0.75. If floor 70 originally needed 30 mm of remaining compensation, the update gives about 30×0.75 = 22.5 mm, applied as +20 or +25 mm in 5 mm increments and settled by later measurements. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個階段由結構工程師出具比對報告：列出各監測斷面的實測、預測、修正比與採用的更新方法，並說明對後續補償與延遲接頭鎖定時機的影響；報告須經業主代表與施工團隊確認後才採用新補償表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At each stage the structural engineer issues a comparison report listing measured, predicted and correction ratios at each monitored section, the update method and its effect on later compensation and delay-joint locking; the new compensation table is adopted only after the owner's representative and the construction team acknowledge the report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 實測與預測比對後的更新：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Updating predictions from measurements: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測量回饋與預測更新」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Survey feedback and prediction update” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個階段由結構工程師出具比對報告：列出各監測斷面的實測、預測、修正比與採用的更新方法，並說明對後續補償與延遲接頭鎖定時機的影響；報告須經業主代表與施工團隊確認後才採用新補償表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At each stage the structural engineer issues a comparison report listing measured, predicted and correction ratios at each monitored section, the update method and its effect on later compensation and delay-joint locking; the new compensation table is adopted only after the owner's representative and the construction team acknowledge the report. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以多個斷面與兩種量測方法（應變計與水準）交叉確認後才更新預測，每次更新都保存舊版與理由，形成可追溯的決策紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Update the prediction only after cross-checking several sections with two methods, strain gauges and levelling, and keep every superseded version with its reason as a traceable decision record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若用單一斷面的異常讀數（例如儀器故障）修正全樓補償，可能把正確的預測改錯；反之若完全不更新，系統性偏差會一路累積到頂層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Correcting the whole building's compensation from one anomalous section, such as a faulty gauge, can spoil a correct prediction; never updating lets a systematic bias accumulate all the way to the top. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.observation: 連結機制：常見做法是比較已完成樓層的實測縮短與同齡期的預測值，求出修正比例，再套用到尚未施工樓層的補償值；若偏差呈系統性（例如所有實測值都偏小），應檢討模數或潛變係數，而不是只做比例縮放。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A common approach compares measured shortening of completed floors with predictions at the same age, derives a correction ratio and applies it to compensation for floors not yet built; if the deviation is systematic, for example all measurements smaller, the modulus or creep coefficient should be revisited rather than merely scaled.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設計階段的縮短預測一旦完成，施工中就不需要再修改。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A design-stage shortening prediction never needs revising during construction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若用單一斷面的異常讀數（例如儀器故障）修正全樓補償，可能把正確的預測改錯；反之若完全不更新，系統性偏差會一路累積到頂層。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「實測與預測比對後的更新」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Updating predictions from measurements" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

Differential shortening is purely a structural matter and has nothing to do with façades, partitions or elevators.
Correcting the whole building's compensation from one anomalous section, such as a faulty gauge, can spoil a correct prediction.
