stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許」與「竣工後追蹤與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Allowances for façades, partitions and risers" and "Post-completion tracking and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Allowances for façades, partitions and risers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「非結構構件的容許變形」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Movement allowances for non-structural elements” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 即使結構補償得當，竣工後仍會有殘餘的長期縮短，加上樓板撓度與溫度變化，非結構構件必須能容納這些位移。帷幕牆的水平堆疊接縫、隔間牆頂部的滑動接頭、電梯導軌的伸縮接頭與立管的伸縮節，都要依每層的預期位移設計。哈里發塔的設計者把退縮配合柱網，使上方的柱落在下方的牆上，平順的傳力路徑也讓構件應力分布較均勻，減少了相鄰構件間的縮短差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「非結構構件的容許變形」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Even with good compensation, residual long-term shortening remains after completion, adding to slab deflection and thermal movement, so non-structural elements must accommodate these displacements. Horizontal stack joints in curtain walls, sliding heads of partitions, expansion joints in elevator rails and expansion fittings in risers must all be designed for the expected movement per floor. At Burj Khalifa the designers aligned setbacks with the column grid so columns above sit on walls below, and the smooth load path also evened out member stresses, reducing shortening differences between neighbouring members. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Movement allowances for non-structural elements” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：堆疊接縫需求 = 帷幕牆安裝後每層柱縮短 1.5 mm + 樓板邊緣活載撓度 10 mm + 溫度 3 mm ≈ 14.5 mm，設計取 ±15 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Stack-joint demand = 1.5 mm of column shortening per floor after façade installation + 10 mm of live-load slab-edge deflection + 3 mm thermal ≈ 14.5 mm, so ±15 mm is specified.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「差異縮短只是結構問題，與帷幕牆、隔間和電梯無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Differential shortening is purely a structural matter and has nothing to do with façades, partitions or elevators." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「非結構構件的容許變形」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Movement allowances for non-structural elements”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Horizontal stack joints in curtain walls, sliding heads of partitions, expansion joints in elevator rails and expansion fittings in risers must all be designed for the expected movement per floor.

knowledge.text: 誤解：差異縮短只是結構問題，與帷幕牆、隔間和電梯無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Differential shortening is purely a structural matter and has nothing to do with façades, partitions or elevators. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Allowances for façades, partitions and risers" is correct?
options: 即使結構補償得當，竣工後仍會有殘餘的長期縮短，加上樓板撓度與溫度變化，非結構構件必須能容納這些位移。
差異縮短只是結構問題，與帷幕牆、隔間和電梯無關。
大樓完工後，柱與核心筒的縮短就已經全部結束。
optionsEn: Even with good compensation, residual long-term shortening remains after completion, adding to slab deflection and thermal movement, so non-structural elements must accommodate these displacements.
Differential shortening is purely a structural matter and has nothing to do with façades, partitions or elevators.
Once the building is complete, column and core shortening has finished.
quiz.explanation: 即使結構補償得當，竣工後仍會有殘餘的長期縮短，加上樓板撓度與溫度變化，非結構構件必須能容納這些位移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Even with good compensation, residual long-term shortening remains after completion, adding to slab deflection and thermal movement, so non-structural elements must accommodate these displacements. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Allowances for façades, partitions and risers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「非結構構件的容許變形」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Movement allowances for non-structural elements” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：堆疊接縫需求 = 帷幕牆安裝後每層柱縮短 1.5 mm + 樓板邊緣活載撓度 10 mm + 溫度 3 mm ≈ 14.5 mm，設計取 ±15 mm。若安裝提早到結構只完成一半時，每層縮短可能增為 3.0 mm，需求約 16 mm，接縫須重新檢討。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Stack-joint demand = 1.5 mm of column shortening per floor after façade installation + 10 mm of live-load slab-edge deflection + 3 mm thermal ≈ 14.5 mm, so ±15 mm is specified. Installing the façade earlier, with only half the structure complete, could raise per-floor shortening to 3.0 mm and the demand to about 16 mm, requiring the joint to be reconsidered. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：結構工程師以書面提供每層的殘餘縮短、撓度與層間變位值，帷幕牆顧問據以設計接縫並做性能試驗；安裝時抽查堆疊接縫寬度是否在允收範圍，完工一年後再量一次確認仍有餘裕。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The structural engineer provides residual shortening, deflection and drift per floor in writing, the façade consultant designs and tests joints accordingly; during installation spot-check stack-joint widths against acceptance limits and re-measure a year after completion to confirm remaining capacity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 堆疊接縫需求 = 帷幕牆安裝後每層柱縮短 1.5 mm + 樓板邊緣活載撓度 10 mm + 溫度 3 mm ≈ 14.5 mm，設計取 ±15 mm。若安裝提早到結構只完成一半時，每層縮短可能增為 3.0 mm，需求約 16 mm，接縫須重新檢討。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Stack-joint demand = 1.5 mm of column shortening per floor after façade installation + 10 mm of live-load slab-edge deflection + 3 mm thermal ≈ 14.5 mm, so ±15 mm is specified. Installing the façade earlier, with only half the structure complete, could raise per-floor shortening to 3.0 mm and the demand to about 16 mm, requiring the joint to be reconsidered. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Allowances for façades, partitions and risers", which statement holds?
options: 樓層越高，需要的縮短補償就越大。
堆疊接縫需求 = 帷幕牆安裝後每層柱縮短 1.5 mm + 樓板邊緣活載撓度 10 mm + 溫度 3 mm ≈ 14.5 mm，設計取 ±15 mm。
鋼柱沒有潛變，所以鋼—混凝土混合塔樓不會有差異縮短問題。
optionsEn: The higher the floor, the larger the shortening compensation it needs.
Stack-joint demand = 1.5 mm of column shortening per floor after façade installation + 10 mm of live-load slab-edge deflection + 3 mm thermal ≈ 14.5 mm, so ±15 mm is specified.
Steel columns do not creep, so steel–concrete hybrid towers have no differential-shortening problem.
quiz.explanation: 堆疊接縫需求 = 帷幕牆安裝後每層柱縮短 1.5 mm + 樓板邊緣活載撓度 10 mm + 溫度 3 mm ≈ 14.5 mm，設計取 ±15 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Stack-joint demand = 1.5 mm of column shortening per floor after façade installation + 10 mm of live-load slab-edge deflection + 3 mm thermal ≈ 14.5 mm, so ±15 mm is specified. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Allowances for façades, partitions and risers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「非結構構件的容許變形」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Movement allowances for non-structural elements” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 結構工程師以書面提供每層的殘餘縮短、撓度與層間變位值，帷幕牆顧問據以設計接縫並做性能試驗；安裝時抽查堆疊接縫寬度是否在允收範圍，完工一年後再量一次確認仍有餘裕。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The structural engineer provides residual shortening, deflection and drift per floor in writing, the façade consultant designs and tests joints accordingly; during installation spot-check stack-joint widths against acceptance limits and re-measure a year after completion to confirm remaining capacity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：協調會議中把縮短與撓度值列為帷幕牆、隔間、電梯與機電的共同設計輸入，各系統的接頭圖說須註明其容許位移並經結構工程師確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make shortening and deflection values a common design input for façade, partitions, elevators and services in coordination meetings, and require each system's joint details to state their movement allowance and be checked by the structural engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接縫容量不足時，帷幕牆單元互相頂住使玻璃破裂或錨件變形；隔間牆頂部沒有滑動接頭會在柱縮短時被壓裂，電梯導軌則可能因長度累積而彎曲，造成運轉振動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With insufficient joint capacity, curtain-wall units bear on each other until glass cracks or anchors deform; partitions without sliding heads are crushed as columns shorten, and elevator rails may bow from accumulated length, causing ride vibration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 結構工程師以書面提供每層的殘餘縮短、撓度與層間變位值，帷幕牆顧問據以設計接縫並做性能試驗；安裝時抽查堆疊接縫寬度是否在允收範圍，完工一年後再量一次確認仍有餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: The structural engineer provides residual shortening, deflection and drift per floor in writing, the façade consultant designs and tests joints accordingly; during installation spot-check stack-joint widths against acceptance limits and re-measure a year after completion to confirm remaining capacity.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 協調會議中把縮短與撓度值列為帷幕牆、隔間、電梯與機電的共同設計輸入，各系統的接頭圖說須註明其容許位移並經結構工程師確認。
knowledge.textEn: Make shortening and deflection values a common design input for façade, partitions, elevators and services in coordination meetings, and require each system's joint details to state their movement allowance and be checked by the structural engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Allowances for façades, partitions and risers"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
延遲接頭越晚鎖定越好，沒有任何代價。
結構工程師以書面提供每層的殘餘縮短、撓度與層間變位值，帷幕牆顧問據以設計接縫並做性能試驗；安裝時抽查堆疊接縫寬度是否在允收範圍，完工一年後再量一次確認仍有餘裕。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Delay joints should always be locked as late as possible at no cost.
The structural engineer provides residual shortening, deflection and drift per floor in writing, the façade consultant designs and tests joints accordingly.
quiz.explanation: 結構工程師以書面提供每層的殘餘縮短、撓度與層間變位值，帷幕牆顧問據以設計接縫並做性能試驗；安裝時抽查堆疊接縫寬度是否在允收範圍，完工一年後再量一次確認仍有餘裕。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The structural engineer provides residual shortening, deflection and drift per floor in writing, the façade consultant designs and tests joints accordingly; during installation spot-check stack-joint widths against acceptance limits and re-measure a year after completion to confirm remaining capacity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Allowances for façades, partitions and risers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「非結構構件的容許變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Movement allowances for non-structural elements” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接縫容量不足時，帷幕牆單元互相頂住使玻璃破裂或錨件變形；隔間牆頂部沒有滑動接頭會在柱縮短時被壓裂，電梯導軌則可能因長度累積而彎曲，造成運轉振動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: With insufficient joint capacity, curtain-wall units bear on each other until glass cracks or anchors deform; partitions without sliding heads are crushed as columns shorten, and elevator rails may bow from accumulated length, causing ride vibration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At Burj Khalifa the designers aligned setbacks with the column grid so columns above sit on walls below, and the smooth load path also evened out member stresses, reducing shortening differences between neighbouring members.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「差異縮短只是結構問題，與帷幕牆、隔間和電梯無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

quiz.question: 在「帷幕牆、隔間與立管的變形容許」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 竣工後追蹤與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-completion tracking and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「竣工後長期縮短紀錄」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-completion shortening records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 潛變與收縮在完工後仍會持續數年，交接時結構只完成了部分的長期縮短。營運單位需要知道還剩多少、何時趨緩，以便安排帷幕牆接縫、電梯與管道的調整與檢查。因此交接文件應包含預測曲線、施工中的實測紀錄、補償施作紀錄與延遲接頭鎖定日期，以及長期監測點的位置與讀數方法；若日後改變用途大幅增加荷重，殘餘縮短也會改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「竣工後長期縮短紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Creep and shrinkage continue for years after completion, so at handover the structure has gone through only part of its long-term shortening. The operator needs to know how much remains and when it slows down, in order to schedule adjustments and inspections of façade joints, elevators and risers. Handover documents should therefore include the prediction curves, construction measurements, compensation records and delay-joint locking dates, plus the locations and reading methods of long-term monitoring points; a later change of use that adds substantial load also changes the residual shortening. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-completion shortening records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With the ACI 209 time function, three years (1,095 days) after loading 1,095^0.6 ≈ 66.6, so 66.6/76.6 ≈ 87% has occurred and about 13% remains.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「大樓完工後，柱與核心筒的縮短就已經全部結束。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the building is complete, column and core shortening has finished." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「竣工後長期縮短紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Post-completion shortening records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「竣工後追蹤與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

潛變與收縮在完工後仍會持續數年，交接時結構只完成了部分的長期縮短。

optionsEn: Once the building is complete, column and core shortening has finished.
Creep and shrinkage continue for years after completion, so at handover the structure has gone through only part of its long-term shortening.

steps.title: 竣工後追蹤與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-completion tracking and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「竣工後長期縮短紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-completion shortening records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 ACI 209 時間函數估算：加載後 3 年（1,095 天）1,095^0.6 ≈ 66.6，已完成 66.6/76.6 ≈ 87%，剩餘約 13%。若潛變總縮短 60 mm，交接後仍有約 60×0.13 ≈ 7.8 mm 會在之後逐年發生。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With the ACI 209 time function, three years (1,095 days) after loading 1,095^0.6 ≈ 66.6, so 66.6/76.6 ≈ 87% has occurred and about 13% remains. If total creep shortening is 60 mm, about 60×0.13 ≈ 7.8 mm still occurs year by year after handover. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：完工後第一年每季、之後每年以精密水準量測代表樓層的柱與核心標高差，並讀取長期應變計，與預測曲線比較；若殘餘縮短明顯超出預測，評估對帷幕牆與電梯的影響並安排調整。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the level difference between columns and core at representative floors quarterly in the first year and annually thereafter by precise levelling, read the long-term gauges and compare with the prediction curve; if residual shortening clearly exceeds the prediction, assess the effect on façade and elevators and schedule adjustments.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 ACI 209 時間函數估算：加載後 3 年（1,095 天）1,095^0.6 ≈ 66.6，已完成 66.6/76.6 ≈ 87%，剩餘約 13%。若潛變總縮短 60 mm，交接後仍有約 60×0.13 ≈ 7.8 mm 會在之後逐年發生。數值為教學假設。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「竣工後追蹤與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-completion tracking and handover", which statement holds?
options: 同一配比的混凝土無論做成牆或柱，收縮量都一樣。
差異縮短只能在完工後以調整裝修高度來處理。
optionsEn: The same concrete mix shrinks the same amount whether it is cast as a wall or a column.
Differential shortening can only be dealt with after completion by adjusting finish levels.
With the ACI 209 time function, three years (1,095 days) after loading 1,095^0.6 ≈ 66.6, so 66.6/76.6 ≈ 87% has occurred and about 13% remains.

steps.title: 竣工後追蹤與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-completion tracking and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「竣工後長期縮短紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-completion shortening records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 完工後第一年每季、之後每年以精密水準量測代表樓層的柱與核心標高差，並讀取長期應變計，與預測曲線比較；若殘餘縮短明顯超出預測，評估對帷幕牆與電梯的影響並安排調整。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the level difference between columns and core at representative floors quarterly in the first year and annually thereafter by precise levelling, read the long-term gauges and compare with the prediction curve; if residual shortening clearly exceeds the prediction, assess the effect on façade and elevators and schedule adjustments. steps.observation: 現場實務：交接清單應包含縮短預測報告、補償與鎖定紀錄、監測點位置圖與讀數程序，並指定負責判讀的結構顧問與量測週期；用途變更或增加大量荷重前須重新評估殘餘縮短。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The handover list should include the shortening prediction report, compensation and locking records, a monitoring-point plan and reading procedure, and name the structural consultant responsible for interpretation and the measurement interval; residual shortening must be reassessed before any change of use or major added load.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交接時沒有預測曲線與基準量測，多年後出現的電梯門檻高差或帷幕牆漏水難以判斷原因，各方可能互相推諉，延誤修復。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without prediction curves and baseline measurements at handover, elevator sill steps or façade leaks appearing years later are hard to diagnose, parties may blame each other and repairs are delayed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「大樓完工後，柱與核心筒的縮短就已經全部結束。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the building is complete, column and core shortening has finished." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若交接時沒有預測曲線與基準量測，多年後出現的電梯門檻高差或帷幕牆漏水難以判斷原因，各方可能互相推諉，延誤修復。
knowledge.textEn: Without prediction curves and baseline measurements at handover, elevator sill steps or façade leaks appearing years later are hard to diagnose, parties may blame each other and repairs are delayed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
